name: tiabwft
description: There Is A Better Way For That: on every prompt Claude also suggests the smarter stack, AI, connectors and skills for the job.

mode.title: Suggestion mode
mode.description: always: a tip on every prompt where one helps. big-asks-only: only for goals like building an agent or automating a workflow. off: no suggestions.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: on: tiabwft learns your stack, decisions, rejections and constraints automatically. off: no memory.

projectFile.title: Project memory file
projectFile.description: commit: .claude/tiabwft/memory.md is a normal file in the repo (works in cloud sessions and for teammates). ignore: tiabwft adds it to .gitignore.

azureSyncUrl.title: Azure sync URL
azureSyncUrl.description: Optional. The URL of your tiabwft Azure Function (see azure/README.md). Empty: no sync.

azureSyncKey.title: Azure sync key
azureSyncKey.description: Optional. The key your Azure Function expects in x-tiabwft-key.
